newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit in HK$500mln spinoff - paper.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit in HK$500mln spinoff - paper.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd plans to spinoff its home electrical appliance division Konrowa in March, raising about HK$500 million, the South China Morning Post reported on Monday.
The newspaper quoted Leading Spirit chairman Wong Shiling as saying the company will make an application to the stock exchange by the end of January and launch the debut in March.
Yuanta Securities and China Development Finance will be the sponsors of the separate listing, Wong said.

The division, which assembles and trades televisions and washing machines, will sell 25 percent of the new shares at HK$1.00 per share, representing a prospective price to earnings multiple of about nine times, the report said.
The spinoff unit is expected to post a HK$200 million operating profit for the year to June 1997, compared with HK$86 million a year earlier, it added.

In October, Leading Spirit had said it was holding discussions on spinning off its electronics arm and listing it in Hong Kong. Leading Spirit supplies components for television, audio and household appliances.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
